blurb: Standalone copy-paste prompts for AI governance work — use-case triage, AI impact assessments, vendor AI review, AI inventory, and regulation-to-policy gap analysis. Each prompt runs on its own; the workflows offer a provisional mode if you have not built a Practice Profile. Every output is a draft for licensed-attorney review.

prompts.title: AI Governance Practice Setup
prompts.description: One-time interview that builds a reusable AI Governance Practice Profile — AI policy posture, frameworks in scope, risk tolerance, and escalation. Optional but recommended.

prompts.title: AI Use-Case Triage
prompts.description: Sort one proposed AI use case into a risk tier and route it — proceed, assess, or escalate — against the EU AI Act and your frameworks.

prompts.title: AI Inventory
prompts.description: Build and maintain an inventory of the organization's AI systems from uploaded records, with risk classification.

prompts.title: AI Impact Assessment
prompts.description: Draft an AI impact assessment for one AI system in your house format from an uploaded description or PRD.

prompts.title: Vendor AI Review
prompts.description: Review one vendor's AI terms — training rights, data use, IP indemnity, transparency — against your AI posture.

prompts.title: Regulation Gap Analysis
prompts.description: Diff an uploaded AI regulation or guidance against your current AI policy into a gap list and remediation plan.

prompts.title: AI Policy Starter
prompts.description: Draft a starter AI governance policy scaffold for your organization to build on.
